problem.statement: People who share a household lose track of chores and errands because their to-do lists live in separate apps and are never in sync.
problem.falsifiableBy: Households that already share one list complete no more items per week than households that do not.

successMetric.name: weekly shared items completed per household
successMetric.dataSource: todo.item.completed events in the analytics warehouse, grouped by household

out: a mobile app (web only in this release)
